remarks: Welcome to 1118 Foxboro Drive! This charming one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bathroom condo in the sought-after Foxboro Condominium Complex has been recently updated and is move-in ready! Featuring new hardwood floors in the living room, dining room, and kitchen, as well as fresh wall-to-wall carpeting in the bedroom and stairwell. This condo offers a cozy living room with a fireplace and a spacious outdoor deck. The kitchen boasts newer cabinets, granite countertops, and updated appliances. The lower level includes a washer and dryer, as well as an in-unit garage and plenty of space for storage. Enjoy amenities such as the community pool, beautiful grounds, and the convenience of being close to major highways, trains, shopping, dining, gyms, and more, all while still enjoying your private and quiet home.
